entities.name: Q9LFB8
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (570 aa) to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana NRT1/PTR FAMILY 8.2.
Annotated as a high-affinity di- and tripeptide transporter; associated with peptide uptake during pollen germination and tube growth.
Annotated at the plasma membrane as a multipass membrane protein; sequence scan detects PTR2 domain PF00854.28 at residues 97–526.

entities.name: Dipeptide transport
observations: Q9LFB8 is annotated for dipeptide transmembrane transporter activity and dipeptide transport.
